items.title: Supporting a shared AI training control for websites
items.description: Today, we're announcing our plans to support a shared AI training control in robots.txt. This will help websites express their AI training preferences across multiple AI providers in a single step and is based on work from the AIPREF working group at the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF). This builds on our long history of providing website owners with clear controls, including through Google-Extended, the AI training control we've offered since 2023.

items.title: New learning paths: curated YouTube playlists for Search fundamentals and Technical SEO
items.description: Over the years, the Search Central YouTube channel has published hundreds of videos across various series, from Search for Beginners and Ask Googlebot to Search Console Training and Search Off the Record. While our series structure works well for deep dives and episodic updates, we know that finding a clear, sequential learning path from scratch can sometimes be challenging.

items.title: Announcing web multimodal Search performance reporting in Search Console

items.title: Search Central Live India 2026: Bengaluru, We're Coming (For Real This Time)

items.title: Update to the Site Reputation Policy
items.description: In 2024, we introduced our site reputation policy to stop a practice where third-party content is published on a trusted website just to exploit that site's good reputation to rank higher in Search. This practice hurts search quality, and creates a bad experience for users.

items.title: Platform properties roll out globally, plus a new social and video performance guide
items.description: Earlier this month, we announced platform properties for Search Console, allowing you to track how your social and video posts on Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube perform on Google Search, Discover, and Google News. Today, platform properties are globally available to everyone.

items.title: See how content from social and video platforms performs on Google Search
items.description: Content creators and publishers use many channels beyond their own websites to reach their audiences. As people gravitate toward firsthand perspectives and different content formats, we want to make it easier for site owners and creators&mdash;even those without their own website&mdash;to get a consolidated view of how all of their content is getting discovered on Search.
